name: bbj
description: The hosted BBj docs MCP server, the BBjSkills, and a compile-only check of every BBj file the agent writes (bbjcpl -N; BBj code is never run).

docs_url.title: BBj docs server URL
docs_url.description: URL of the BBj docs MCP server; the default is the pre-production instance until the go-live release.

bbj_home.title: BBj installation directory
bbj_home.description: BBj installation directory for the compile-only check; empty means BBJ_HOME, BBJHOME, PATH, then the usual install locations.
